session.title: Kiara Enduro setup - 2 x Twin Peaks
session.purpose: Use a controlled Kiara Enduro session to test the Zeb setup while building enduro-specific climb-to-descent repeatability without turning the day into a high-load race simulation.

dose.terrain: Bukit Kiara / Twin Peaks route family
dose.cap: Two Twin Peaks climbs only; total ride cap 135 minutes; no third climb or extra descent unless the first descent is aborted for safety or mechanical reasons.
dose.climb_target: RPE 3-5 / mostly Z2; short trail surges are fine but no sustained threshold climbing.
dose.descent_target: Two high-quality descents with race-line attention, not race-day risk.
dose.setup_variable: Fork setup package only: 65 psi and one click more HSC than the last Kiara Enduro test; leave other bike variables unchanged.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: Two climb-to-descent cycles should give enough fatigue to judge whether the Zeb setting improves root compliance while preserving support, without creating the recovery cost of a full enduro-volume day.
execution_rules: Warm up on the first climb; do not attack the lower half.
Use descent one as feel calibration: braking comfort, root compliance, front support, and corner-exit confidence.
Use descent two as confirmation under mild fatigue: same lines where practical, same aggression ceiling, no extra setup changes.
Keep the setup test narrow: fork setting only; do not change tires, pressure, cockpit, route, or intensity mid-session.
Wear the external HR strap and make sure the activity is tagged to the Enduro.

expected_result.garmin_load: moderate MTB load, likely below last Friday's high-load Kiara day if the two-climb cap is obeyed
expected_result.next_day: yellow or better readiness with no upper-body hangover that compromises Friday/Saturday trail quality
expected_result.technical_result: Clear yes/no notes on root compliance, brake support, corner support, and whether confidence improves on descent two.

stop_rules: Stop descending or take the easier exit if braking timing gets late, vision narrows, or line choice becomes reactive.
Do not add a third climb if Garmin load feels high, RPE exceeds 6/10 on the second climb, or heat starts driving sloppy riding.
Abort the setup test if the fork rides harsh enough to reduce grip or confidence over wet roots.
End the session immediately for crash, near-crash, mechanical issue, or sharp pain.
